description: This Dart script is a utility designed to determine and print the absolute path to the Flutter project root directory. It searches upwards from the current directory for specific files (`pubspec.yaml` and `lib/main.dart`) to identify the project root, which is useful for CI/CD automation.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory in the filesystem, providing methods for path manipulation and navigation.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file in the filesystem, providing methods to check for existence and read contents.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the process to find and print the Flutter project root directory.

methods.name: _findFlutterRoot
methods.description: Searches upward from the given directory to find the nearest directory containing both 'pubspec.yaml' and 'lib/main.dart'.
